learnings: `compile()` checks code without running it – perfect for linting snippets.
`TabError` is a subclass of `IndentationError`, which is a subclass of `SyntaxError`, so order the `except` clauses from specific to general.
Different blocks may use different (consistent) indentation; only lines in the same block must match.
pitfalls: Expanding tabs to 4 spaces created a new indentation error – the tokenizer measures tabs to multiples of 8.
next: Let `ruff format` own indentation in every future file.
